title: The Patrol Journal
moral: Careful observation and thinking can be as powerful as bravery.

scenes.summary: Rowan begins his patrol with a journal.
scenes.text: Rowan, a young knight, records his observations carefully during patrol.
scenes.image_prompt: young knight writing in journal while riding pony, cheerful cartoon

scenes.text: The patrol finds a broken shield and suspects bandits nearby.
scenes.image_prompt: knights examining broken shield on forest path

scenes.text: Rowan observes a hidden trap on a bridge and helps the team avoid danger.
scenes.image_prompt: young knight pointing at hidden trap on bridge

scenes.text: Rowan discovers bandits disguised as guards planning attacks.
scenes.image_prompt: bandits wearing fake armor inside ruined tower

scenes.text: The team captures the bandits and Rowan proves his intelligence.
scenes.image_prompt: knights capturing bandits while young hero watches proudly

story: Sir Rowan, a young knight, uses his journal to carefully observe his surroundings. He discovers traps and uncovers bandits pretending to be guards. His intelligence helps protect the kingdom and proves that thinking is a true form of bravery.
